advisory.finding: The replacement link is derived twice by two independent code paths: `close_precheck._has_live_replacement_link` decides the disposition branch, then `close_disposition.verdict` -> `find_replacement` re-derives it via separate `reduce_ticket`/`find_inbound_relationships` reads. dropped.finding: A disposition close mints a certified `completion-verifier` attestation whenever the named replacement is merely a LIVE ticket, without verifying that the replacement's own completion is certified — so a parent's certification can propagate through a replacement whose work was never verified. This diverges from the ticket's AC #3 ('a disposition-closed child whose replacement is itself uncertified DOES still withhold certification') and the candidate remedy ('certified iff the replacement's own closure is certified-and-valid').
scenarios: A bug is closed --class duplicate naming a live but never-completed (open/in_progress or force-closed) replacement; the disposition attestation certifies the child and lets its parent epic certify, even though no completion of the replacement's work was ever verified.
An agent seeking to certify an unattested subtree points a disposition link at any live ticket to forward certification without verification.
